questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I am sure that my seeds ______ by next week.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'will grow'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'will grow'.**
 
• In the given sentence **'next week' **is an adverb of **'future simple tense'.**
 
• Other adverbs of **'future simple tense'** are **'tomorrow, today, later today, in five minutes, in two hours, on Monday, on Saturday afternoon, next week/month, this year, etc.'**
 
 
• *Example: Bob will go to the library **tomorrow**.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__ ***I am sure that my seeds **will grow** by next week.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प** 'will grow' **है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में** 'next week'** **'future simple tense'** का **adverb** है।
 
• 'future simple tense' के अन्य adverbs हैं 'tomorrow, today, later today, in five minutes, in two hours, on Monday, on Saturday afternoon, next week/month, this year, etc.'।
 
 
• *Example: Bob will go to the library **tomorrow**.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3 **है।

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The trek manager ______ the trekkers to rest for a while before the climb.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**insisted**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**insisted**'.
 
• It means** 'to say firmly that something is true (when somebody does not believe you); demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal'**. [आग्रह करना]
 
 
• *Example: She **insisted** on her innocence.*
 
 
 
• ​The** trek manager **would insist or strongly advise the **trekkers to rest before the climb for their safety and well-being**. It's not a casual suggestion; it's more of a strong urge recognizing the physical demands of the trek.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The trek manager __**insisted**__ the trekkers to rest for a while before the climb.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **warned**: to tell somebody about something unpleasant or dangerous that exists or might happen, so that he/she can avoid it. [आगाह]
 
• **informed**: give (someone) facts or information; tell. (सूचित किया)
 
• **told**: to give information to somebody by speaking or writing. [कुछ बताना, जानकारी देना (बोलकर या लिखकर)]
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• **"Told" **could theoretically work in this context, but it is a bit too neutral and doesn't convey the sense of urgency or concern for the trekkers' well-being that** "insisted"** does.

• As per the **subject-verb agreement rule**, a singular entity should be followed by a singular helping verb.
 
• **'Hundred and fifty rupees' **is **a singular subject.**

**Correct Sentence:__*** Hundred and fifty rupees **seems a high price** for this little vase.*
